messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: methRead reads only 6 rows
parts:
Hi Miljana,

If you use `head()` on a methylKit object you only get up to six rows of the object printed. Call without head() instead:
> my.obj.Nanopore
This should print summary for whole object.

Best,
Alex
